description: Create file. Supply exactly one of `content` (plain text) or `content_base64` (strict standard Base64 representing exact bytes).

content.description: Plain-text content. Exactly one of content/content_base64 is required; an explicit empty string is valid.

content_base64.description: Strict RFC 4648 standard Base64 for the exact file bytes. Exactly one of content/content_base64 is required; an explicit empty string represents zero bytes.

name: create_file
